MHTN.title: Mar Holidays Travel Network
MHTN.subtitle: The Challenge: Simplifying Complexity
MHTN.description: The challenge was to build a platform from scratch that was powerful yet incredibly easy to use. After analyzing the competition, we focused on simplifying every process to drastically reduce the learning curve, ensuring that new users feel like experts from the very first moment.
MHTN.description2: My approach was to radically simplify the booking flow. I redesigned the entire process to turn it into a linear, guided experience, eliminating unnecessary steps to make booking faster. To make this possible, I introduced key tools such as smart filters to simplify complex searches, visual comparison tools for agile decision-making, and a main dashboard that provides full control over bookings and notifications at a glance.
MHTN.description3: For the interface, I built a design system from scratch to give the platform a coherent and scalable visual identity. I created a library of reusable components—from buttons to information cards—and defined a color palette and typography focused on readability to reduce visual fatigue. The result is a clean interface with universal iconography that naturally guides the user, making navigation feel completely intuitive.
MHTN.subtitle4: The Outcome: A Powerful and Easy-to-Use Tool
MHTN.description4: The result was a tool that had an immediate impact, completely transforming the user experience. The new design not only modernized the platform but also drastically optimized its functionality, allowing agents to complete bookings in much less time with a notable reduction in errors. This project demonstrates my ability to turn complex systems into successful, seamless solutions, delivering a final product that is as efficient for the business as it is user-friendly.

padelpals.title: Padelpals, Challenge Friends and Padel.
padelpals.subtitle: The Challenge: Control and simplify padel match management
padelpals.description: Having padel as a hobby, the need was identified for a web and mobile application that allows the management and recording of game data in an optimized way.
padelpals.description2: Based on match creation and score control, an experience was developed grounded in market analysis and research. All grid designs and prototypes have been created for implementation within the app. It has been planned in 2 stages: the first being a web application focused on mobile-first, and subsequently the creation of the native application. A custom-built design system has been implemented for the app, along with its components.
padelpals.description3: In this case, custom components have been created to meet the project's needs. Based on the research conducted, components have been designed to offer a unique experience on any type of screen.
padelpals.description4: This project is still in the development phase, and is expected to launch in the coming months for functional testing and use with a larger number of users.
